sources.name: Exophase
sources.what: official trophy list — names, descriptions, grades

points_note: PSN points per grade: bronze 15, silver 30, gold 90, platinum 180. Total for all 55 trophies: 1,230 points.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own once the other 54 are earned. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, then the counted grinds, then the missable watch list — and leave the clean-up trophies for last.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is the first mission in the game, so this is usually the first trophy a player earns.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Main missions only — keep following the story and it pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Main missions only — keep following the story and it pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. Main missions only — keep following the story and it pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. Main missions only — keep following the story and it pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Play the final mission to the end. It is the last mission of the story — before you start it, clear the missable watch list, since the story may not let you go back afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the mission Breakfast Run to the end. Main missions only — it pops when the mission closes.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play the mission The Cartel Heist to the end. Main missions only — it pops when the mission closes.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play the mission Child's Play to the end. Main missions only — it pops when the mission closes.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Play the mission Headliners to the end. Main missions only — it pops when the mission closes.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play the mission VCIA Takedown to the end. Main missions only — it pops when the mission closes.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play the mission Operation Savage Glory to the end. Main missions only — it pops when the mission closes.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the long one: every mission, activity, collectible and strand counts toward it, so treat it as the last trophy before the platinum and watch the in-game completion counter as you go.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. PSNProfiles tracks the count to 250. Stunts add up across the whole game — jumps, near-misses and air time all count — so play aggressively and check your counter in the stats menu.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. PSNProfiles tracks 9 types. Play one round of every activity the game offers and it pops; you do not need to win any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. PSNProfiles tracks 42 challenges. Gold every challenge at the range; bring the best weapon you have for each one and retry the ones you miss.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 in total. PSNProfiles tracks 14 locations. Learn each course once, then win it; a win at every location is what counts.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — road, off-road or water — so spread your wins across race types instead of repeating the same one.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him; no special gear is named by the sources, so use the best rod you have.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Walk into any arcade and finish a game to the end — the first full playthrough is enough.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Play Andy's strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Play Kenton's strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play Billy's strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. PSNProfiles tracks 8 strands. Pick up every stranger mission you meet and finish each strand; the map markers are your checklist.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Play Tyrone's strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. PSNProfiles tracks 18 spots. Visit every meditation spot and complete the session at each one.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand — the target animal is unique, so the hunt only counts once you take that specific animal.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; finish any 3 full sets. Keep a checklist of the sets you have started so you do not chase the same set twice.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. PSNProfiles tracks 100 locations. The counter is the long grind — tag every spot you pass and check the total in the stats menu.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. PSNProfiles tracks 50. Challenges span the whole game, so this pops naturally if you play broadly; check which ones you have left in the challenges menu.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the wanted level clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies in a row with your partner, keeping the same wanted level through all three — do not get busted or lose the cops between shops.
trophies.fact: 3 shops in a row, with partner

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. PSNProfiles tracks 100. Drive or enter every new vehicle type you see; the counter moves on first discovery, so variety beats repetition.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group of at least 5 in a shooting fight, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it ends — pick a crowded fight, not a lone enemy.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Our reading: this looks missable from the description wording — it sounds like a one-off moment at the airport — but the trigger is unconfirmed; the game released 19 Nov 2026, so treat this as a watch item and do it the first time you are at VCIA rather than assuming you can come back.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Deal with the Rhino tanks — the description does not name a count, so engage them when they appear in missions or free roam and the trophy will pop once the requirement is met.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan the approach, stay out of sight lines, and leave before any alarm — a single detection fails the attempt, so retry clean.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vaults, each followed by a clean escape. Plan the getaway before you go in — the escape is part of the requirement.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit one armored truck and get away clean; the escape counts, so do not stop for a second score on the same run.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. PSNProfiles tracks 52 areas. Drive through every named area until the map is filled in; the counter moves per area, so check which areas are still unvisited.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. PSNProfiles tracks 9 gangs. Hit one operation per gang — nine gangs, nine hits.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Our reading: this looks missable from the description wording — it sounds like a one-off moment at a specific place — but the trigger is unconfirmed; the game released 19 Nov 2026, so do it the first time the opportunity appears rather than assuming it waits.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Our reading: this looks missable — it sounds like a single scripted-style moment in a showroom — but the trigger is unconfirmed; the game released 19 Nov 2026, so attempt it the first time you are in a showroom rather than later.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a full game at that alley; the trophy is about completing the visit, not your score.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Our reading: this looks missable from the description wording — it sounds like a one-off partnership moment — but the trigger is unconfirmed; the game released 19 Nov 2026, so watch for the moment and do not assume it repeats.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSNProfiles tracks a count to 500. Our reading: this looks missable — the description points at choices that may not be repeatable — but the trigger is unconfirmed; the game released 19 Nov 2026, so make the choices as they come and do not rely on a second playthrough for the count.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Our reading: this looks missable — it sounds like succeeding on a second try at something specific — but the trigger is unconfirmed; the game released 19 Nov 2026, so when you fail something once, try it again right away instead of moving on.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Our reading: this looks missable — it sounds like witnessing a one-off strange event — but the trigger is unconfirmed; the game released 19 Nov 2026, so when something strange happens, stay and watch it through rather than driving past.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Hit someone with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by, but with a melee weapon instead of a gun.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. PSNProfiles tracks $250,000. Launder marked bills through your contacts until the total hits $250,000; it is a cumulative total, so keep at it between missions.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. PSNProfiles tracks $100,000. Spend across any shops — weapons, clothes, cars — the total is cumulative, so it pops as you play.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. PSNProfiles tracks 8 garages. Buy every garage property on the map; save up and check the property list for the ones you still lack.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register any 10 vehicles in the app — first registration of each vehicle counts.
